howto.what: 装上后，Claude会复制Matrix适配器、注册它、安装指定版本的依赖、修补ESM导入，并构建和运行测试，让项目能通过Matrix收发消息。
howto.when: 当你说要接入Matrix或添加Matrix频道时。

say.note: Claude会执行添加Matrix的完整步骤。

say.text: 把Matrix适配器安装到项目里。
say.note: 触发复制适配器、注册、构建测试等步骤。

say.text: 设置Matrix机器人的账号信息。
say.note: 会提示输入服务器地址和凭据。

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Matrix adapter, registers it, installs a pinned dependency, patches ESM imports, builds and tests, enabling Matrix messaging.
howto.when_en: When you ask to add Matrix support or connect the bot to Matrix.

say_en.note: Claude will run the full steps to add Matrix.

say_en.text: Install the Matrix adapter into the project.
say_en.note: Triggers copying, registering, building, testing, etc.

say_en.text: Set up the Matrix bot account information.
say_en.note: Prompts for server URL and credentials.
